product_metadata.title: KITOSUN Electric Charcoal Starter 600W – Superior BBQ Grill Fireplace Coal Lighter Easy & Quick Ignite Briquettes |No Sparks or Flames | 304 Stainless Steel Coils Elements 5ft Long Cable (600W)
features: Powerful and Reliable Electrical Coal Burner: Designed to provide continuous heat for coals and ignite them within a few minutes. It is simple and easy to use. Just insert the heat elements into the coal pile. Only wait 8-10 minutes. Easy, Quick, and Efficient

Cleaner & Safer than Other Fire Starters: Uses Electricity Instead of Lighter Fluid or Matches. There will be no flame or sparks. The equipment does not have a blowing function, so no sparks will be blow out. There is no need to worry about spontaneous combustion during storage. No fire risk.

Faster & Energy-Saving : The exclusive letter M design heat element, Enables heat direct reach more coals, 600W power can release super strong and plenty heat to the coals. The heat element is made of 304 Stainless Steel. Which will more durable

User Friendly: A 1.5M/5ft long thick AWG 16# cable which is flexible for tall or short grills. The wind can't affect it. Because it doesn't burn charcoal with flames. In addition, you don't need to hold it all the time. It will silently ignite the coals for you. Just bury the heat element in the coal piles and plug in the electricity. That is it.The handle is made of heat-resistant plastic, Which is very durable and handy. Help you to move it out from the heat sources.

Widely Use : Compatible with Weber, Kamado, Royal Gourmet, Char-Griller, Big Green Egg and more Barbecue grills and smokers. Also useful for indoor & outdoor Fireplace, Campfire, RV Camp, Wood Stove, Fire pit, Pizza Oven. READ INSTRUCTIONS BEFORE USE. And Keep Children Away from it.
